The `build()` and `package()` functions use standard qmake6/make build and install procedures, setting version info from git describe and installing into `$pkgdir`.

No obfuscated code, unexpected network requests, eval/base64/curl/wget usage, data exfiltration, or system modifications outside the package scope are present. All operations are consistent with ordinary AUR packaging practices for a Qt6-based image viewer.
